Captured openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-1B-int4 — 2 GB manifested, license: unclassified

This week the archive captured 32 new open-weight model repos, led by the MiniCPM-V-4.7 family from openbmb: the 1B and 35B-A3B variants landed in base, GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ, int4, FP8, and DSpark builds. Other additions include stepfun-ai's Step-5-Preview in BF16 and NVFP4, tencent's Hy-Memory-30B-A3B (base, FP8, GGUF), inclusionAI's Ming-3.0 audio/ASR/TTS and Ling-3.1-flash, deepseek-ai's DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, and Skywork's Matrix-Game-4.0. No mirrors or alerts were recorded this week; radar signals were mostly new papers referencing DeepSeek and Qwen, plus an HN front-page post on Parsimony, an open-source benchmark for how
